{{Top|leg}}
A '''color sensor''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] incorporated into the [[Vectac Systems, Inc.]] [[Versatex Survival Suit]]. It scanned a desired color, then mixed a series of tinted dyes to match the selected color. The dye was then injected into the suit's microcapillaries, changing the color of the suit to match the background.
